The release where the books get their remaining screens, and the interface becomes our own. Since v1.3.0 (October 19, 2026) every ledger operation that existed only on the API or over MCP has a page: the account register, receivables and payables, the chart editor, posting rules, the opening balance sheet, the close settings, the group lifecycle. Reports open onto how each figure was made, and the books leave as CSV. Underneath, the app moved off the Flowbite component library onto UI primitives owned in `@robosystems/core`. The series went out as ten patch releases; this file is the account of it as a whole.

## 📒 The books, on screen

- **Account Register.** One account's posted lines with a running balance, in a window that defaults to the month to date. A statement figure, a trial balance row, a closing-book account and a journal line each open it, and every line opens the event it came from (#503, #504)
- **Receivables and payables.** An aging page by days past due, an open-balance tile on a counterparty, and a picker in the Inbox to say which bill or invoice a bank line pays (#500)
- **The chart of accounts is edited in the app:** add, rename, re-code, move and retire accounts, and retired accounts come back to the page (#520, #523)
- **Posting Rules.** A page for the event handlers that turn a matching event into journal entries, with a queue for the rules an AI client proposes: nothing books until a person approves it, and an approval covers exactly the version reviewed (#517, #527)
- **The opening balance sheet, entered once,** in the two places it belongs: calendar setup and the entity page (#515)
- **A counterparty's tax ID and 1099 flag,** set in the app. The ID shows as its last four digits, Change opens an empty field, and Remove is its own action (#519)
- **The income statement by department, class, location or project,** one column per member, then Unallocated, then Total, with the footer saying whether they tie; the trial balance by one member, with each account linking to its register on the same slice; and the Inbox's flow on the shared select (#502, #518)
- **Books as files.** The trial balance, an account's register, a live statement and a published report's statements each export as CSV. Text that could run as a formula is neutralised in every export (#505, #506, #527)

## 🏢 Groups and the close

- **The group lifecycle in the app:** record an acquisition, a change in share, a deconsolidation, and former members, each a draft in the consolidation entity that the group close posts; set the outside owners' share of a member's month; and a new blocker names a member's unmapped accounts (#521, #525)
- **Consolidated reports and consolidating-entry tags.** On the group parent, Create Report offers the consolidated group beside the parent alone, and a journal entry posted in the consolidation entity can say what it adjusts (#499)
- **The close panel names what holds the group's month,** lists the items behind each blocker, and offers to close with the difference unexplained when that is the only one. Drafting the consolidating entries re-reads what holds the close, and a month the engine left an entry out of says so instead of calling the drafts stale (#489, #490, #491, #493)
- **Close settings:** set or change the close target, end a schedule early, and set a reconciliation's materiality and review policy. Held bank lines, those that synced in after their month closed, are named and can be closed over knowingly, and a stale outstanding line on a reconciliation reads as not counted (#511, #512, #516)
- **The schedule form takes custom curves and loans,** previews the schedule, and edits a definition in place (#524)
- **A new member's join date** on the New Entity form, which a group that has closed a month requires (#492)
- **Every page reads the entity in focus,** never the group parent's books, and a feed card names the entities its accounts book to (#497, #498)

## 📈 Reports

- **A published figure opens onto how it was made:** the accounts it was summed from, each opening its register for the column's window, the lines it rolled up, or the parts a computation put together, and whether the column is the closed record or still following the books (#507)
- **The holon with lineage.** A published report's download menu offers the holon with its lineage graph, so an auditor or lender can trace a number to the books in the viewer with no account, and the in-app holon view walks a figure to its ledger lines the same way (#508, #509)
- **Manage shares lists the report's actual recipients** instead of guessing them from current list membership (#513)

## 🎨 The interface is ours

- **Every component the app renders now comes from `@robosystems/core/ui`,** the UI layer owned in the shared core package, in place of the Flowbite React library. Nothing you see changes: the cutover was gated on full-page screenshots of all thirty-nine routed pages in light and dark, on desktop and mobile, against the previous release, and every one rendered identically. Your dark-mode choice carries over untouched (#535)
- **The contact form's overlay is translucent again.** It had been solid since the Tailwind v4 upgrade (#535)

## 🌐 Public site

- **The homepage catches up with six weeks of shipped features,** names the price, and adds groups and consolidation as a first-class part of the page without making it the headline (#529)

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- The Block Explorer's overlay comes down after a silent reload on a graph with no facts, plan money rounds correctly, and a stale auto-map result is dropped after a graph switch (#514)
- The consolidation entity's name stays legible on the Entities page, and Draft review mentions QuickBooks only on books that have it (#495)
- Register polish from a browser pass: the journal's event chip, the register's subtitle, and the wording around them (#504)

## 🔒 Hardening

- CSV exports neutralise formula-shaped text, the report page validates its graph id, and a posting-rule approval is bound to the reviewed version (#527)

## 🔧 Infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 2.20.2 → 2.35.0,** carrying every read and write above. **`@robosystems/core` 0.15.0 → 0.19.0,** with the owned UI layer in 0.18. **`@robosystems/report-components` 0.9.0 → 0.13.0,** with CSV from a pivot, the fact inspector's "How it was made" and the holon's lineage walk (#489, #491, #499, #500, #502, #503, #505, #506, #508, #509, #512, #521, #523, #525, #526, #527, #535, PR_SELF)
- **Flowbite, flowbite-react and the `deepmerge-ts` override they forced are gone** from the dependency tree, and the image no longer copies the generated class list. `npm audit`'s remaining findings are one `minimatch` advisory reached only through the eslint toolchain, dev-only (#535)
- **The app runs on Node 26,** the active LTS since October 28: the image base, the workflows, `engines` and the type definitions move together, and the vitest workers turn off Node's own Web Storage so the browser-style storage the tests use stays jsdom's (PR_SELF)
- **Next 16.4.** vitest 4.1 and Vite 8.3; vitest 5 is held until its 5.1 line (#496, #532)
- **For forks and self-hosters:** the app requires Node 26 and `@robosystems/core` 0.19.0 or later, and a per-call Flowbite `theme` object has no equivalent; the Modal, Card and Alert primitives accept a partial `theme` merged over the defaults (#535)

## 📦 Deploy notes

- **The API is already ahead of this release.** Everything the new pages read and write shipped in the robosystems releases now in production: the register, aging and dimension reads, posting rules as proposals, the group lifecycle, the close settings and the report lineage.
- **The production image moves to Node 26.** Nothing in the stack changes with it; watch the first run's logs as with any runtime change.
- **No CloudFormation changes** across the series.
- **No new variables or secrets.**
